ResourceHeader.Description: The following table provides a list of bow shock (BS) crossing times. The 1st column gives the time of the last BS crossing as the spacecraft was leaving the Earth magnetosheath. The 2nd column gives the first full hour which has only unshocked solar wind data in it. The 3rd column gives the last full hour which still contains interplanetary magnetic field data, and finally the last column gives the time of the 1st BS crossing on the way into the Earth magnetosphere.

Parameter.Name: Last BS crossing
Parameter.Description: The time of the last BS crossing as the spacecraft was leaving the Earth magnetosphere.

Parameter.Name: 1st hr kept
Parameter.Description: The first full hour which has only unshocked solar wind data in it.

Parameter.Name: Last hr kept
Parameter.Description: Tthe last full hour which still contains interplanetary magnetic field data.

Parameter.Name: 1st BS crossing
Parameter.Description: The time of the 1st BS crossing on the way into the Earth magnetosphere.
